name: Takasaki [Maebashi]
registryAssessment: Takasaki City is the first-party local cadastral/map custodian evidenced here: its Asset Tax Division publishes the city's parcel-number map data and its official map system exposes the parcel-number map. The public data is explicitly reference-only and not a legal boundary or survey record.

queries.query: Takasaki City Japan official cadastral map parcel GIS public map
queries.result: Found Takasaki City's official cadastral-map/parcel-number information page, open-data catalogue, map system, and downloadable parcel-polygon Shapefile. The official source states the parcel-number map covers Takasaki City and is reference-only.

queries.query: 高崎市 地籍図 公開 GIS 公式
queries.result: 高崎市公式ページで地籍図・地番図を確認。高崎市オープンデータに筆ポリゴンのシェープファイルが公開され、座標系は世界測地系2011・平面直角座標第9系と明記されている。まっぷdeたかさきの地番図も確認した。

officialSources.observation: Lists citywide 地番図 Shapefile downloads, including 筆ポリゴン_地番図, and identifies Asset Tax Division as the responsible department. Notes say the data shows parcel-number arrangement for reference, does not represent parcel boundaries or rights, is not for applications, and may differ from measurements.
Anonymous HTTPS GET succeeded. ZIP contains 筆ポリゴン_地番図.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj; 577,988 polygon features. The polygon attribute schema is FUDEID, documented as a parcel geometry management number.
Documents the dataset extent as Takasaki City, creation date 2026-01-01, CRS JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS IX, polygon file 筆ポリゴン_地番図.shp, and FUDEID as the parcel geometry management number.
States that Takasaki cadastral maps show land shape and parcel number without owner names, and directs users to the city open-data site and まっぷdeたかさき for parcel-number maps.

Anonymous GET succeeded. Current viewer HTML/config exposes the 地番図 theme and map.js configuration with the public API base https://www.sonicweb-asp.jp/takasaki2/api/; no login was used. The downloadable Shapefile was used for safe bounded geometry verification.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact WUP point [36.3622938663979, 139.038838162225] is inside FUDEID 299414 after transforming the source JGD2011 Japan Zone 9 coordinates to WGS84. The point was not shifted.
geometryDecision.crs: Source JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS IX (EPSG:6677); retained sample is WGS84 GeoJSON (EPSG:4326).
